name: SP Chaudhary Aslam 'The Jinn'
role: Karachi counter-terror officer / Lyari Task Force commander — complex neutral
real_life_inspiration: Chaudhry Aslam Khan — Karachi's most feared counter-terror officer, commanded the Lyari Task Force, personally led raids on Rehman Dakait's network. Killed in a January 2014 suicide bombing on his convoy (claimed by TTP). Known as 'The Jinn' on the streets.

inspiration_notes.real_death: Chaudhry Aslam was killed 9 January 2014 when a suicide bomber targeted his vehicle on Karachi's Lyari expressway. Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) claimed responsibility.
inspiration_notes.lyari_task_force: The real LTF was formed in 2008 specifically to take on the Lyari gang wars. Aslam led brutal operations against Rehman Dakait and Uzair Baloch's factions.
inspiration_notes.film_complexity: In the film, Aslam is neither purely an ally nor an obstacle for Hamza. He is fighting the same criminal network Hamza has infiltrated. But he is Pakistani law enforcement — if he discovers an Indian RAW operative on his patch, he would almost certainly arrest or eliminate Hamza, regardless of shared objectives.
inspiration_notes.oracle_classification: side='unknown' — Aslam is a tactical wildcard. The oracle models him as a NEUTRAL adversary: not targeting India, but his investigations into Lyari's criminal network create cover-integrity risk for Hamza. High capability (8.5), low predictability.

oracle_role_note: Not a playable operative (Pakistani national). Modelled as a 'neutral high-capability actor' in the alliance_snapshot — in_coalition=false, but betrayal_history=0. His death in the film (mirroring the real 2014 bombing) may be a turning point in Film 2.

adversary_model.objective: Eliminate Lyari's criminal networks — will inadvertently threaten Hamza's cover in the process
